annotations.title: Daily price index finwire (online shelf prices)

description: Use for daily online prices of a basket of food, household and personal care products. For official CPI, use get_macro_indicator. Experimental daily index of online shelf prices of a fixed basket of food, drinks, household and personal care products in three Polish online shops (finwire_daily_price_index), base month = 100: latest value and change since the base month, basket categories with change since the base month and month on month, categories with the largest rise and fall, monthly readings, the food part vs GUS CPI food and non-alcoholic beverages for the same completed month, and the collection state (days, products, stores, expected first reading) while the base month is being collected. Online prices only, not CPI; no prices of single products or shops.
name: get_daily_price_index
